patch_list: Stops advertising identifier and app set ID collection, install-referrer attribution, Google measurement, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Sessions upload, turns off Facebook's advertiser identifier and event upload, and empties the Sen…
Blocks Beacon ad loading and showing using its own failure callbacks on the original UI-thread dispatch, skips bidder-token collection, and disables ad SDK initialization and startup providers.
Hides the paid Shop tab and content, Treasure Pass purchase button and paid reward row. Keeps Bonus, Daily Deals, free rewards and quests.

Declares Angry Birds 2 a parked game app, so Android Auto and car hosts like DriveDeck and Gearslip list it on the car screen by themselves. Android Auto still needs Unknown sources in its developer settings for a patched app.
